column1: # Reviewed incremental Ocarina Vulkan shader updates.

# the fallback. Never list a new chain without reviewing which shaders were
# affected by that exact change. If not provably scoped, leave this file without
# an active row: the existing full/verified delta process is used instead.
# Current translation is intentionally unaffected while the user builds the
# 42,339-shader baseline for 600c17b98391. Add an approved row with both exact
# versions and the actual changed keys before a later update is released.
